name: Syncabinet
description: A vendor-specific (SynapseF) customer-cabinet module for the syncart Commerce suite: it restyles the core login/register/password/profile forms into a themed "личный кабинет", adds optional VK/Facebook social-login links, a user logout tab, a registration/password confirmation page, and a repeat-order flag on Commerce orders. Depends on syncart. Review auth behaviour in context.
version_note: Documented from installed on-disk source (release 2.0.5); not test-enabled this wave because its syncart/Commerce (cml) configuration dependencies were not installed.
